_note: Transcription of the exact Railway Template Composer settings for the Laravel AI SDK starter. Railway does NOT read this file automatically — enter these settings in the Template Composer when publishing, and check the published page against this file. Reference variable values are set by the Template Composer at publish time; verify them against the published page. sourceRepo/sourceBranch are set at publish time, once the GitHub repo exists — do not invent a repo URL before then.
description: Laravel 13 starter with the AI SDK, Postgres and healthcheck
name: Laravel AI SDK Starter
notIncluded: Auth scaffolding (no users, no login, no tokens)
Any AI provider key — the demo reports configured: false until you set one
Vector store, embeddings pipeline, or RAG — the demo is one text agent call

build.note: Dockerfile pins php:8.5.12-fpm-alpine exactly. Railpack/Nixpacks resolve PHP fuzzily and cannot pin the patch — see Dockerfile header.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic key for the demo agent (tried after OpenAI).

APP_KEY.description: Laravel encryption key. Generated at deploy time — never ship a real value in this repo.

APP_URL.description: Public URL of the deployed app (the Railway domain, once generated).

DATABASE_URL.description: Connection string for the Postgres service in this template.

DB_CONNECTION.description: Database driver. pgsql on Railway; sqlite only for local parity testing.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Google Gemini key for the demo agent (tried after Anthropic).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Set ONE provider key to make the demo call a real model. OpenAI is tried first.

services.name: Postgres
services.note: Railway Postgres service. The app connects over the private network via DATABASE_URL.

volumes.note: Persistent volume. Without it, data is lost on redeploy.

stillUntestedAtPublish: Live Railway deploy of this template (waits for a paid Railway plan to be active)
Railway's own Postgres service round-trip (local parity test ran on SQLite only)
Nixpacks/Docker build on Railway's side (local Docker build not possible in this VM)
